eligibility_note: Own system-GMM estimation; exposures are household internet access/use plus e-government and e-commerce use (ICT in general/internet); outcome is TFP (output/productivity); 27 EU member states counted as economies (Table A1 lists 27 countries summing to 182 regions), so the 10-economy rule is met on countries.

sample_corrections.regions_detail: Record's '173 NUTS2 plus 9 single units' is derived, not printed; paper says nine countries use 'NUTS1-level data' while Table A1 prints 'Total NUTS2 region = 182'. Quote (p.4): 'treats countries such as Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Ireland, Malta and Slovenia using NUTS1-level data'

heterogeneity.correction: Only interaction terms among proxies and descriptive scatterplot remarks; no subgroup estimation, no threshold. Authors state sector/geographic heterogeneity is left for future work.
heterogeneity.quote: we do not provide sector-wise analysis while the empirical literature reveals a heterogeneous impact on productivity

income_group_note: No income-group split or classification; EU27 only.

risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: causal wording ('increases TFP', 'accelerates') while only lagged TFP and GDP (t-2, t-3) are declared endogenous and instrumented; digital proxies are not, and authors disclaim causality.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: moderate; three Eurostat percent-of-individuals/households shares capture use but not investment or quality, and authors admit partial coverage.
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: moderate; all 27 states but nine enter as one unit, unbalanced panel (2362 obs vs 2266 in Table 4), no income comparison.
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: agree: moderate; eq. (1) uses fixed 2/3 and 1/3 factor shares although text claims a changing-weight translog index; Malmquist 'robustness' reuses the same fixed-share construction (eq. 6); lnTFP built from lnGDP, which also enters as lagged control.
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: serious; instrument count and AR(2) not reported (AR-1 and AR-3 only), mechanical TFP/GDP link, proxies entered one at a time because of collinearity, some printed stars inconsistent with SEs (e.g. Ln GDP 0.3067** (0.013)).
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: moderate; all 18 models shown, but text says results hold across all estimations despite insignificant/negative terms; data stated to be confidential.
risk_of_bias.why: Standard dynamic-panel set-up without exogeneity of the digital proxies established and with causal framing; serious is appropriate.

problems: (a) Record says the 0.08 percent reading 'does not match the units'; this is too strong: dependent variable is ln TFP (eq. 2) and regressors are percentage shares, so 0.0008 is a semi-elasticity, roughly 0.08 percent per percentage point (text wording '1 percent rise' is loose). (b) Result 5 direction should be mixed. (c) '173 NUTS2' is inferred (182 minus 9). (d) Other record notes verified: text claims no serial correlation but only AR-1/AR-3 printed; Table 4 col (15) prints '0077***'; Table 4 has 2266 obs vs 2362. No invented numbers or mixed-up papers found; no instructions to the reader in the text.
